releaseState: Local candidate qualified; purpose copy, metadata, complete agent catalog, Ask AI composition, analytics repair, and the manga statistics route fix are not deployed by this audit.

contentPurpose.evidence: The first viewport states the exact job: search more than 35,000 anime and manga titles using MyAnimeList catalog fields, without requiring sign-in. It distinguishes public discovery from the optional private watchlist, and the FAQ now truthfully states the 20,600-title manga coverage and available quality fields.

designQuality.evidence: The existing dark catalog interface is polished, distinctive, and fit for discovery; no template migration is warranted. Exact 390 and 1440 pixel checks found zero horizontal overflow, and the latest candidate includes one project strip plus one independently composed Ask AI footer.

seo.evidence: The latest candidate passes all 14 critical homepage checks: concise 45-character title, description, canonical, social metadata, JSON-LD, direct H1, two useful no-JavaScript H2 sections, and no broken homepage links. The only advisory is a deliberately lean approximately 245-word SPA shell. The candidate serves /manga/stats successfully; production still returns a stale 404 until an authorized release.

geo.evidence: Source now builds 13 canonical Markdown surfaces and /api/ai maps all 13 HTML/Markdown pairs while publishing MCP separately as a data resource. The production host remains A-tier 90 because its Worker still exposes the older incomplete catalog; the source catalog and Worker dry-run qualify for the next authorized release.

performance.evidence: PSI Swarm completed 4/4 candidate profiles at performance scores 98 to 100. Slow-3G LCP was 1.71 s with 94 ms TBT; mid-mobile LCP was 874 ms, fast mobile 465 ms, desktop 525 ms, and CLS was 0 throughout. Dead fallback vitals requests were removed in favor of the existing analytics path.
